name: example-brand-2026-10
notes: Copy this file, rename it, and edit. Settings you leave out use the defaults. Real job files (jobs/*.json except this one) are gitignored because they list real creators.

partying.label: Party energy
partying.description: high-energy party content: club or party scenes, dancing crowds, nightlife, festival or rave atmosphere. A quiet dinner or small calm gathering does not count

drinking.label: Alcohol
drinking.description: someone consuming alcohol, or alcoholic drinks clearly visible or promoted. A bottle on a shelf behind someone does not count by itself

levels.incidental: a glass of wine with a meal, a bottle in the background
levels.notable: drinking is clearly the focus of part of the post
levels.heavy: visibly drunk, drinking games, alcohol is the point of the post

swearing.label: Swearing
swearing.description: profanity in on-screen text or in the caption
